title: Matson, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Matson, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting held on April 23, 2026. All seven director nominees were elected, executive compensation was approved in an advisory vote, and the appointment of Deloitte & Touche LLP as the company's independent registered public accounting firm was ratified.
key_points: Seven directors elected at the 2026 Annual Meeting: Meredith J. Ching, Matthew J. Cox, Mark H. Fukunaga, Stanley M. Kuriyama, Constance H. Lau, Bradley D. Tilden, and Jenai S. Wall
Advisory vote to approve executive compensation passed with 24,143,908 votes for and 290,726 votes against
Deloitte & Touche LLP ratified as independent auditor for fiscal year 2026 with 26,561,608 votes for
No broker non-votes applied to the auditor ratification proposal
Filing signed by Peter T. Heilmann, Executive Vice President, CAO and General Counsel
